about: Minimum line coverage, checked by tools/check_coverage.dart after `flutter test --coverage`. The minimums sit a little under what the tests reach, so coverage can only go up: raise them when it does. A library counts in the first area whose paths match it.

excluded.lib/main.dart: the entry point: one line handing over to bootstrap()
excluded.lib/bootstrap.dart: device set-up (screen orientation, immersive mode, the phone's audio): runs only on a device
excluded.lib/report/share_report.dart: hands the error report to the system's share sheet (share_plus): runs only on a device
